groups.add.heading: Add Group
groups.edit.heading: Edit Group
groups.package_prices.heading: Package prices
groups.package_prices.hint: Set the price for each listing when booked as part of this package. Leave blank to use the listing's own price.
groups.package_prices.no_listings: Add listings to this group to set their package prices.
groups.delete.heading: Delete Group
groups.delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group {name} ({slug})?
groups.delete.listings_note: Listings in this group will not be deleted. They will be moved out of the group.
groups.delete.confirm_prompt: Type the group name "{name}" to confirm.
groups.detail.attendees_scope: across all listings in the group
groups.detail.share_unavailable: This package isn't currently bookable (an incomplete bundle or a sold-out member), so its public page 404s — no link, embed, or QR code until it can be booked.
groups.fields.name: Group Name
groups.fields.max_attendees_hint: Limits total attendees across all listings in this group. Leave blank for no limit. Works best when all listings in the group are the same type (daily or standard).
groups.fields.terms_hint: If set, overrides the global terms and conditions for this group ticket page
groups.running_totals_error_explanation: Expected values come from attendee rows in this group. Got values are the sum of stored running totals on the group's listings. Normal attendee changes keep these aligned; recalculate the affected listing totals before relying on group capacity or reporting.
groups.running_totals_error_title: Group listing totals do not match attendee rows.
groups.money.heading: Money in and out
groups.money.note: These totals combine the group's current listings. View every change in the group's money.
fields.group.name: Group Name
fields.group.terms_hint: If set, overrides the global terms and conditions for this group ticket page
fields.group.max_attendees_hint: Limits total attendees across all listings in this group. Leave blank for no limit. Works best when all listings in the group are the same type (daily or standard).
fields.group.is_package_hint: A package is sold as a bundle: each listing has its own per-unit price and a fixed quantity included in one package. Buyers pick how many packages to book. Pay-what-you-want listings cannot be packaged.
fields.group.is_package_label: Sell this group as a package
fields.group.hide_package_listings_hint: When set, buyers, tickets, and confirmation emails show only the package name — not the listings inside it. Admins still see the full breakdown.
fields.group.hide_package_listings_label: Hide the package's listings from buyers
fields.validation.terms_max: Terms must be {max} characters or fewer
error.package_member_pay_more: Packages cannot contain ''{name}'' — it lets the buyer choose their own price, and a package needs a set price for each item. Remove it from the package, or turn off Allow Pay More.
error.package_member_is_addon: Packages cannot contain ''{name}'' — it is offered as an add-on of another listing, so it can only be sold together with that listing, not on its own in a package. Remove it from the package first.
error.package_member_gates_children_hidd: Packages cannot contain ''{name}'' while the package is hidden — it offers its own add-ons, and their selector would reveal the listings a hidden package conceals. Un-hide the package's listings, or remove it.
error.package_gate_in_hidden: This listing is in a hidden package, so it can't offer its own add-ons — the add-on selector would reveal the package's hidden listings. Un-hide the package's listings, or take this listing out of the package, before adding children.
error.package_child_is_member: A listing that belongs to a package can't also be an add-on of another listing — a package member is only sold as part of its package. Remove it from the package first.
error.package_member_no_children: a hidden package's member cannot require children
error.sold_hidden_package: This hidden package has sold tickets whose display depends on it. Un-hide its listings first if you want to un-package or delete it.
